sources.disposition: 2026-04-08 v3;260 configurations/six benchmarks, not older180/four summary. Task alignment matters; no universal optimal headcount or45% launch rule.
Effective diversity/correctness redundancy differ from nominal size; fit claims are source-reported and not independently reproduced here.
Routing trades quality against cost; benchmark preference results do not validate agreement-based factual routing here.
Vendor experience about task boundaries, tool context and coordination. Reported15x token use is relative to chat, not a15x single-agent ratio.
RL analogy for matched-experience acquisition/transfer controls; not evidence of LLM culture.
Borrow observation/state/action/outcome separation; no local benchmark deployment or reproduction.
Cost-sensitive acquisition motivates a candidate; model-estimated probability is not true calibration. Full methods/abstract domain discrepancy not resolved.
Self-reflection/stance/reasoning controls and root clustering. Operational counterfactual categories do not reveal internal psychology.
